title: The End of Consensus Research?
abstract: arXiv:2610.30114v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Consensus is a fundamental problem in distributed computing and at the core of state machine replication (SMR). Despite decades of active human research, discovering practical low-latency solutions to the problem is still open, as it requires combining protocol knowledge, correctness reasoning, implementation, and experimental evaluation. We report on how AI helped us discover A-greement, a new consensus protocol for geo-replicated state machines that significantly outperforms state-of-the-art solutions. Averaged across six deployments with 5 or 9 replicas, A-greement reduces the mean latency of a geo-distributed key-value store over the fastest baseline by 12.2% and 33.3% on write-heavy and read-heavy workloads, respectively, and matches the fastest baseline on read-only workloads. translated_abstract: 共识是分布式计算中的一个基础性问题，也是状态机复制（SMR）的核心。尽管经过数十年积极的人类研究，为该问题找到实用的低延迟解决方案仍是一个开放性难题，因为它需要综合协议知识、正确性推理、实现以及实验评估。我们报告了AI如何帮助我们发现了A-greement——一种面向地理复制状态机的新型共识协议，它显著超越了现有最先进的解决方案。在6个包含5个或9个副本的部署中取平均值，A-greement在写密集型和读密集型工作负载下，分别将地理分布式键值存储的平均延迟较最快的基线降低了12.2%和33.3%，并在只读工作负载下与最快基线持平。A-greement结合了租约授权的本地读取、针对领导者排序写入的直接客户端学习，以及为每个键选择的快速固定仲裁写入路径（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 借助AI发现了面向地理复制状态机的新型共识协议A-greement，通过租约授权本地读取、直接客户端学习和快速固定仲裁写入路径等机制，将地理分布式键值存储的平均延迟较最快基线最高降低33.3%。
en_tdlr: AI helped discover A-greement, a new consensus protocol for geo-replicated state machines that reduces mean latency by up to 33.3% over the fastest baseline by combining lease-authorized local reads, direct client learning, and fast fixed-quorum per-key write paths.
